visit_station:
Image 1 is the CHARACTER and STYLE reference: keep these exact two grandparents and this exact art style (image 2 shows grandpa outdoors and their snowy garden). Grandma Hana: silver-white hair in a small round bun with a red ball hairpin, round gold-rimmed glasses, crescent smiling eyes, rosy cheeks, a soft pink hand-knitted cardigan over a lavender blouse with a round collar, a white apron. Grandpa Gen: bald on top with fluffy white hair at the sides, big bushy white eyebrows, a round white moustache, a round red nose, small round sparkly black eyes, a navy padded hanten jacket with a white cross pattern over a grey sweater.

Art style EXACTLY like image 1: soft modern cel animation with a light, airy palette, thin coloured lineart (warm brown), flat pastel colours with one soft-edged but still flat shadow tone, simple clean backgrounds, warm and heart-warming like an anime film. Hand-drawn feel, NOT glossy. The grandparents are cute, small and round, about 5 heads tall, storybook-cute but NOT chibi.

Dusk at a tiny snowy countryside train station: a short wooden platform, a small wooden station building with a warm lit window and an old lamp post, snow falling, snowy mountains far away, a little one-car local train standing at the LEFT edge. Grandpa Gen stands on the platform slightly RIGHT of centre, full body at a few metres, holding a dark umbrella with snow on it and waving his other hand high with a big happy grin; he wears a knitted red hat and a grey scarf with his hanten. Blue dusk with warm lamp light.

First-person view: you are the grandchild (only, at most, your hands may show). Keep the bottom fifth of the picture calm (subtitles).
